note.msg: Streaming is cheap (new bytes only); replay is the slow part and it is our code: voice session 8,360 lines replays in 2.1 s, 10x e00f55c9 in 6.2 s (superlinear: Session.js:104,122 + Item.lists), while a 115k-line editor tree replays in 0.24 s. Tail.js shares one offset per file across sockets: a lost update, reproduced. SessionTasks re-replays the whole session on every streamed batch. Safe compaction = a sidecar snapshot that never touches the log.
